messages:
Maya Singh: Hey team — putting together a tiny cheat-sheet for folks writing self-reviews and for managers writing feedback. Wanted to share the draft and get quick additions (1-2 lines per role). Deadline: end of week. :sparkles:

Alex Carter: Love this. Adding some IC eng lines: 
- 'Consistently reduced 95th percentile latency by 18% through batching and kernel tuning.'
- 'Owned rollout for model v2 with minimal user impact (A/B <0.5% error rate).'

Priya Patel: Manager phrasing suggestions: 
- 'Provides clear technical trade-offs and escalates early when risks appear.'
- 'Mentors peers on debugging production regressions and improves runbook quality.'

Maya Singh: These are great. Can we add a quick OKR-friendly format? Something everyone can copy/paste into the self-review. Example: 
```
Objective: Improve inference reliability
Key Result 1: Reduce P95 tail latency from 220ms to <180ms by Q3
Key Result 2: Implement KV cache for hot prefixes; achieve 12% cost reduction
```

Alex Carter: Nice. For engineers, micro-snippets for self-review 'what I shipped' section: 
- 'Shipped prefix caching for recurrent flows; measured 9% token cost drop.'
- 'Introduced automated smoke tests for model rollouts, catching 3 regressions.'

Jordan Lee: From people-ops: reminder to call out context and metrics, not just adjectives. e.g., instead of 'improved performance' use 'reduced median latency by 25ms on prod traffic (N=2M requests)'. Also add a short manager checklist: 
- Acknowledge outcomes + coach on 1 growth area
- Tie feedback to next quarter's development plan

Priya Patel: Quick manager micro-scripts for calibration: 
- Praise: 'Your ownership of the rollout prevented a major incident; excellent operational judgment.'
- Growth: 'I'd like you to document handover steps to reduce single-person risk; let's pair next month.'

Maya Singh: Perfect. I'm going to paste this into the People Ops wiki page. One more ask: can eng leads add 2 role-specific lines (infra, ml infra, product) by EOD?

Alex Carter: I added infra/ML infra lines in the doc — short and specific. Example: 'Reduced batch mismatch errors by adding schema validation; eliminated 4 incident pages.'

People Ops Bot: Friendly reminder — performance cycle self-review form opens in 3 days. Link: https://intranet.redwood/okrs/self-review :calendar:

Maya Singh: Thanks everyone — I'll publish the consolidated cheat-sheet and tag managers. If you see anything to soften for ICs vs managers, flag it here and I'll adjust language.
